propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs hang for 1.7–4.3 hours at 99% progress on stale Gerrit patchsets 1129/1130/1131/1136 that omit blob-prefetch fix 96a0d5c3f, causing per-blob lazy-fetch RPC loop (~2.1h for 25k files).
Test job lacks job-level timeout-minutes, defaulting to GitHub 360-minute limit, requiring manual run cancellation to clear queued workers when hangs occur.

FakeJiraClient.search_issues ignores startAt/maxResults pagination kwargs, causing test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract to loop infinitely on the same issue list and timeout at 3s on affected patchsets.
Reusable workflow _build-and-test.yml test job documents 10–16 minute normal execution; 60-minute timeout-minutes bound aligns with documented SLA and eliminates manual-clearing dependence.
Commit 96a0d5c3f fixes blob-starved lazy-fetch on main; stale patchset 1129 PS3 persists independent test pagination defect in _paged_search caller that multiplies hang duration.

FakeJiraClient pagination fix and workflow timeout-minutes addition are both necessary; workflow timeout alone does not repair test infinite loop, and test repair alone without timeout leaves future hangs uncontained.
